content: The sky is the same azure blue wherever your feet may wander.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Aseman-e hameh ja hamin rang ast (آسمان همه جا همین رنگ است)
explanation: We constantly fantasize about moving to a new city, switching jobs, or relocating to an island, believing external geography will cure our internal melancholy. But wherever you travel, you take your restless mind with you. Peace is found in the heart, not in the passport.
practicalInsight: Stop daydreaming that a change of scenery will fix your restlessness. Make peace with where you stand right now.
reflectionPrompt: What internal dissatisfaction are you trying to outrun by changing physical locations?
